main_text.l: Israelitis tollitote. Si quis puellam
virginem viro pastam nactus in oppido copres-
serit, ambos ad illius oppidi portam eductos
lapidatote, & necatote puellam, quia in
oppido non clamaverit: virum, quia
alterius uxorem subegerit: id nefas de me-
dio vestrum tollitote. Sin autem ruri pu-
ellam desponsatam nactus vir, ei vim in-
tulerit, eamq; compresserit, mor tor vir
ille tantum, qui eam compressit: puella
autem nihil nocetote, neq; enim in capi-
tali crimine est: hoc enim perinde est, ac si
quis alterū aggressus vita privet. Nam
ruri eam reperit, neque clamanti puella
desponsa adfuit, qui succurreret. Si quis
puellam virgine non desponsam nactus,
ei stupru intulerit, & deprehensi fuerint,
vir ille patri puellae quinquaginta argen-
teos dato, eamq; uxorem habeto, quod e-
am subegerit, neq; unquam repudiare
liceto. Deuter.22.
LXIX.

l.i: Si quis uxorem duxerit, fœminamq; fe-
cerit, si contigerit eam illi non placere,
quòd aliquid in ea offenderit inhone-

page.notes: Page is a Latin-language page of "Nuptiales" (marriage law text) with Deuteronomy citation. Continuation of the sentence at page foot ("inhone-") is hyphenated. Doubtful readings: "mortor" was printed as "mor tor" with a space; "virgine" and "stupru" are as printed. The printed "Deuter.22." is a marginal-style reference set in the text and transcribed as printed. Marginal notes and the header ornament were not clearly legible.
